definitions.explanation: The hand tightly closed with fingers curled into the palm. Used literally when describing a physical gesture, and figuratively to convey determination, anger, or readiness to fight.

examples.japanese: {握|にぎ}りこぶしを{作|つく}る。
{怒|いか}りで{握|にぎ}りこぶしが{震|ふる}えた。
examples.english: My clenched fist trembled with anger.

examples.japanese: {選手|せんしゅ}はゴールを{決|き}めた{瞬間|しゅんかん}、{握|にぎ}りこぶしを{天|てん}に{突|つ}き{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: The moment the player scored, they thrust a clenched fist into the air.

notes:
Compound of {握|にぎ}り (grasping) + こぶし (fist). Also written as {握|にぎ}り{拳|こぶし}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {握|にぎ}りこぶしを{作|つく}る / {握|にぎ}る — to make/clench a fist
- {握|にぎ}りこぶしを{突|つ}き{上|あ}げる — to raise a fist (in triumph)
- {握|にぎ}りこぶしで{叩|たた}く — to hit/bang with a fist

RELATED WORDS:
- こぶし: fist (shorter, slightly more literary; also the name of a type of magnolia)
- {手|て}のひら: palm of the hand
